correctness.rationale: The reduced Świątkowski chain model is reconstructed explicitly. In particle weight 3 there are 6528 degree-three generators and no degree-four generators. The degree-three boundary has rank at least 6521 because its reduction modulo 3 has rank 6521, and rank at most 6521 because seven attached integral kernel vectors are linearly independent. Thus the rational kernel has dimension 7; as an integral kernel inside a free abelian group it is free of rank 7. The verifier also checks the chain condition for the constructed signs.

value.rationale: The Pappus graph is a standard cubic symmetric distance-regular graph and Levi graph of the Pappus configuration. Its three-particle configuration space is a natural graph-braid object. Determining the exact integral top homology gives a nontrivial configuration-space invariant and a compact benchmark for Świątkowski-complex computations; the rank-seven result is not a mere reparameterization or a known-table recomputation in the checked sources.
